fields.instruction_en: Enter your full name as on Aadhaar. SMAM provides subsidy on agricultural machinery and equipment. SC/ST farmers and women get higher subsidy (up to 50%).
fields.instruction_hi: Aadhaar ke anusar poora naam likhein. SMAM krishi yantra aur upkaran par subsidy deti hai. SC/ST kisaan aur mahilaon ko zyada subsidy milti hai (50% tak).

fields.instruction_en: Select your category — SC, ST, Small/Marginal farmer, or Other. Subsidies under SMAM vary by category: SC/ST/women get up to 50%, others get 40-50%.
fields.instruction_hi: Apni shrenee chunein — SC, ST, Laghu/Seemant kisan, ya Anya. SMAM ke tahat subsidy shrenee anusar alag hai: SC/ST/mahilaon ko 50% tak, anyon ko 40-50% tak.

fields.instruction_en: Select the agricultural equipment you want to purchase — tractor, power tiller, harvester, sprayer, seed drill, etc. Subsidy amount depends on equipment type.
fields.instruction_hi: Khareedna chahte yantra chunein — tractor, power tiller, harvester, sprayer, seed drill, aadi. Subsidy rashi yantra ke prakar par nirbhar karti hai.

fields.instruction_en: Enter total land holding in hectares. Equipment subsidy eligibility and amount may vary based on land holding size.
fields.instruction_hi: Kul bhoomi dhaaraata hectare mein likhein. Yantra subsidy paatrata aur rashi bhoomi dhaaraata ke aakar par nirbhar ho sakti hai.

fields.instruction_en: Enter bank account for subsidy disbursement after equipment purchase verification.
fields.instruction_hi: Yantra khareed verification ke baad subsidy vitaran ke liye bank khata likhein.

fields.instruction_en: Enter 12-digit Aadhaar for KYC and subsidy transfer.
fields.instruction_hi: KYC aur subsidy transfer ke liye 12 ank ka Aadhaar likhein.
